name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
description: Precision-preserving text-only recipe for Qwen's official Qwen3.8 FP8 checkpoint on one NVIDIA GB10.
limitations: Beta 0.1 FTW preparation preserves the official checkpoint's native 128x128 block-FP8 weights and scales and does not perform conversion-time requantization.
The Qwen4-Exp loader must be extended and validated against the official per-expert FP8 tensor layout before this recipe can prepare or serve a complete checkpoint.
GB10-QWEN38-FRONTIER-001 certifies the superseded NVFP4-converted 0.3.0 artifact and does not transfer to this official FP8 0.4.0 recipe.
QSA selection currently runs eagerly, so CUDA graph capture is disabled.
The published checkpoint is multimodal; initial Spark Lab certification is text-only.
The official FP8 runtime-memory budget, performance, exact 64K recall, endurance, and quality gates have not yet been measured on GB10.
